A '''rescue mission''' to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] was undertaken by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
At an early stage<ref name="Date" /> in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] of a transfer of Rebel prisoners of war from the prison [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] to the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Xwing" /> [[Tiger (Imperial-class)|''Tiger'']],<ref name="XWOSG" /> with only two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] from [[Alpha Squadron]] escorting the five [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] loads of prisoners aboard [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] [[213]], [[224 (Lambda-class)|224]], [[227]], [[247]], and [[249]].<ref name="Xwing" />

Attributing the light escort to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] overconfidence, the Alliance conceived of a plan, assigning five shuttles of their own, [[Rescue 1 (Lambda-class)|''Rescue 1'']], [[Rescue 2 (Lambda-class)|''2'']], [[Rescue 3 (Lambda-class)|''3'']], [[Rescue 4|''4'']], and [[Rescue 5|''5'']], along with three [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL Y-wing starfighters]] from [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]], to the rescue mission.<ref name="Xwing" />

==The mission==
Red Squadron's [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] initiated the attack, disabling the Imperial shuttles and destroying their TIE escorts. With the convoy incapacitated, the Rebel shuttles arrived in the [[Kessel system/Legends|system]], docked with their Imperial counterparts, and recovered all Rebel prisoners.<ref name="Xwing" /> At the same time, the Y-wing pilots intercepted three successive waves of three [[Beta Squadron/Legends|Beta Squadron]] [[TIE/IN interceptor]]s,<ref name="XWOSG" /> reinforcements from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], destroying several of them.<ref name="Xwing" />

==Aftermath==
All [[Rebel pilot/Legends|rebel pilots]] participating in the rescue were awarded the [[Corellian Cross/Legends|Corellian Cross]] for their bravery.<ref name="Xwing" />

The engagement was later simulated as a training mission by the Rebel Alliance, intended to teach prospective Y-wing pilots to identify enemy craft and disable them with their [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]]. [[Agamarian]] Rebel [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was assigned to the simulation by [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]] [[Wex Dafid]] prior to Farlander's recruitment into the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]{{'s}} Red Squadron.<ref name="XWOSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] as the fourth Y-wing historical mission, "Prisoners from Kessel."<ref name="Xwing" />

While the Imperial Star Destroyer present during this mission is identified as the ''Tiger'' by ''X-Wing''{{'s}} [[X-Wing: The Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]]<ref name="XWOSG" /> and gameplay, the pre-mission briefing refers to it as the ''Predator''.<ref name="Xwing" />
